name: fellix
description: Work your Fellix inbox from ChatGPT: clients and their companies, conversations across web chat, WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger, appointments and open times, leads and reports.

interface.longDescription:
Fellix is the inbox, client book and calendar of a service business. Connect it and ChatGPT can work in your Fellix account when you ask: look up a client, their company and their history, read a conversation, draft and send the reply, take a thread or hand it to a colleague, move a lead through the pipeline, see which meeting types you offer and when the next open time is, and book, reschedule or cancel an appointment. It can also give you the numbers: what is waiting, what was won and lost, how the team and each channel are doing, and which tags are rising.

ChatGPT acts as you. It sees only the conversations you see in Fellix, can do only what your role allows, and only within the permissions you approve when you sign in. Everything it sends goes out under your name. Tools that send or change something are marked as write actions; your ChatGPT permission settings decide whether it asks you before running one. Disconnect it at any time from Profile → Connected apps in Fellix.
defaultPrompt: Brief me on my Fellix inbox: what is waiting and what needs me first.
Which warm leads have not heard from us in three days?
What appointments do I have today?

positive.description: Finds a client and summarises their latest conversation.
positive.prompt: Find the client Maria Lopez and summarise her last conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Maria Lopez and gives a short, accurate summary of her latest web-chat conversation.

positive.description: Lists the companies in the client book with how many clients each has.
positive.prompt: Which companies are in my Fellix client book, and how many clients does each have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Harbor Light Design with 2 clients and Cedar Row Fitness with 1 client.

positive.description: Finds a client's company and reads its record.
positive.prompt: Which company does Maria Lopez work for, and what does it do?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Maria Lopez, names her company Harbor Light Design and describes it from its record: a small interior design studio with 12 employees, website harborlight.example.

positive.description: Reads the meeting types and booking rules, then finds open times for one meeting type.
positive.prompt: What can clients book with us, how much notice do we need, and what is the first open time for a colour consultation next Tuesday?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the two meeting types, Appointment (30 minutes, 2 hours' notice) and Colour consultation (60 minutes, one day's notice), bookable up to 14 days ahead, with business hours Monday to Saturday 9:00 to 18:00 Pacific time. Then checks next Tuesday for the Colour consultation type and gives its first open time, 9:00 AM unless that hour has been booked since.

positive.description: Sends a reply in an existing web-chat conversation.
positive.prompt: Reply to Maria Lopez's web chat: "Thanks Maria, see you at your next appointment."
positive.expected_behavior: Posts the message in Maria Lopez's web-chat conversation under the reviewer's name. In the recorded demo ChatGPT sent it at once, because the prompt gives the exact text; whether it asks first depends on the plugin's tool permission setting in ChatGPT.

negative.description: Payments are outside Fellix and no tool takes them. ChatGPT should say it cannot charge a card and call no tool.
The number belongs to the client Test Client, but the organization has no WhatsApp channel. ChatGPT should send nothing and say that Fellix Review has no active WhatsApp channel.
negative.prompt: Send a WhatsApp message to +1 202 555 0199 saying our shop is open.

negative.description: No tool deletes clients. ChatGPT should say it cannot delete clients and change nothing.
negative.prompt: Delete all my clients in Fellix.

publication.release_notes: Companies: list the companies in your client book and read one, and see which company a client belongs to. Booking: see the meeting types you offer, your booking rules and business hours, and the open times for a meeting type before you book it.
